book.name: LOS HECHOS
book.title: LOS HECHOS Jesús buerã cʉ̃ja ca tiirique

content: Pedrore, Juan're wiorã pʉtopʉ cʉ̃ja ca ami waarique
Ména, Juan, Pedro, bojocare o biro cʉ̃ja ca wede niirora, paia, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yaa wiire ca coterã uwamarã wiogʉ mena, to biri Saduceos mena eaupa.
Pedro, Juan, “Ca bii yairicarã cʉ̃ja ca cati tuarije Jesucristo menara bii bau niicãupa,” bojocare cʉ̃ja ca ĩi wederije jʉori bʉaro ajiaupa.
To biri cʉ̃jare ñee, ñamipʉ ca niiro macã, ape rʉmʉpʉ cʉ̃jare jãiñarʉgarã tia cũurica wiipʉ cʉ̃jare tia cũucãupa.
To ca bii pacaro, Pedro cʉ̃ ca wederijere ca tʉoricarã paʉ tʉo nʉnʉjeeupa. To biri Jesús're ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã ʉmʉa wadora, jĩcã amo cõro mil cõro peti eacoaupa.
Ape rʉmʉ peere Jerusalén're judíos wiorã, bʉcʉrã ca jʉo niirã, doti cũuriquere ca jʉo buerã, neaupa.
Paia wiorã Anás, Caifás, Juan, Alejandro, to biri paia ʉparã yaarã ca niirã niipetirã, toore niiupa.

Nea poo yapano, tia cũurica wiipʉ ca niirã, Pedro, Juan're ami doo doti, cʉ̃ja jʉguero cʉ̃jare nʉcõri, o biro ĩi jãiña jʉo waaupa: —¿Ñee doti majirique mena, ñiru wãme mena, atere to biro mʉja tiijãri? —cʉ̃jare ĩiupa.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩi jãiñaro Pedro pea, Añuri Yeri cʉ̃re cʉ̃ ca majiorije mena, o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi yʉʉupi: —Bojocare ca doti niirã, to biri Israel macãrãre ca jʉo niirã:
Mʉja, mecʉ̃re, ca diarique cʉtigʉre añuro jãa ca tiirique jʉorira jãare jãiña, “¿Do biro cʉ̃ tii catio ecojãri?” jãare ĩi jãiña, mʉja ĩi.

To biri mʉja niipetirã mʉja ca tʉo cojoro, ñucã Israel yepa macãrã niipetirã cʉ̃ja ca majipere biro ĩirã, ani ca bʉʉricʉ ca niimiricʉ, mʉja niipetirã mʉja ca ĩa cojoro ca niigʉa, Jesucristo Nazaret macʉ̃, yucʉ tenipʉ mʉja ca paa pua tuu cõaricʉrena, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca cati tuaro cʉ̃ ca tiiricʉ cʉ̃ ca doti tutuarije mena catio ecojãwi.
Jesucristoa,

content.text: “Mʉja, wiijeri tiiri maja, ʉ̃tãga ca añutiricare mʉja ca beje cõamiricagara, mecʉ̃ra yua ʉ̃tãga ca nii majuropeerica ca nii earicʉ, niimi.”

content: To biri apĩ jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera ñañaro mani ca biipere manire ca ametʉenegʉ manimi. “Ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca bii yaiboriquere cʉ̃ jʉori ametʉarucuma,” ĩigʉ Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca tiicojoricʉ, ati yepa niipetiropʉrena apĩ manicãmi —cʉ̃jare ĩi yʉʉupi Pedro.
Ʉparã pea, Pedro, Juan, uwi tʉgoeñaricaro maniro cʉ̃ja ca wedero ĩarã, ca buetiricarã nii,
watoa macãrãra niicã, cʉ̃ja ca biirijere ĩa maji, ñee pee ĩi majiticã, biima ĩirã, “Jesús buerãra niima,” ĩi majiupa.
Ñucã ca bʉʉricʉre cʉ̃ja ca catioricʉ pee cãa cʉ̃ja menara cʉ̃ ca niiro macã do biro pee cʉ̃jare ĩi boca yʉʉ majiticãupa.
Do biro pee cʉ̃jare ĩi majitima ĩirã, cʉ̃jare witi waa doti, too ca nearicarã wado o biro ameri ĩi wede peni niiupa:
—¿Anijare do biro mani tiirãti? Jerusalén macãrã niipetirãpʉra ca bʉʉricʉre cʉ̃ja ca catioriquere maji peticãma. “To biro biicãro bii, yee ĩima,” mani ĩi majiti.
Ate bojoca watoare õo jañuro bii jeja nʉcã waare ĩirã, Jesús yeere jĩcʉ̃ peerena cʉ̃ja ca wedetipere biro ĩirã, “Ñañaro mʉjare jãa tiirucu,” cʉ̃jare mani ĩi uwiojaco —ameri ĩi wede peniupa.
To biro ĩicãri, cʉ̃jare jʉo cojo: —Jesús yee maquẽre jĩcã wãme ʉno peera bue, wede majio, tii nemoticãña yua —cʉ̃jare ĩiupa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩiro, Pedro jãa pea o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi yʉʉupa: —¿Mʉjara, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca ĩa cojorore Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca dotirije peere tʉo nʉnʉjeetirãra, mʉja ca dotirije peere jãa ca tʉo nʉnʉjeero, to añucãgajati? Mʉja majuropeera tʉgoeña bejeya.
Jãa, jãa ca ĩariquere, jãa ca tʉoriquere, jãa wede yerijãa majiti —cʉ̃jare ĩi yʉʉupa.

To biro cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ ca ĩi yʉʉrijere tʉorã, ʉparã pea ñucã: —Teere mʉja ca wedejata, ñañaro mʉja tii ecorucu —cʉ̃jare ĩi nemo, cʉ̃jare piticãupa. Ñañaro cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ja ca tiipa wãmere do biro pee tii bʉaticãupa, niipetirã bojoca ca biirique cʉ̃ja ca ĩariquere Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre cʉ̃ja ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉo niiro macã.
Ca bʉʉricʉre cʉ̃ja ca catioricʉ pea, cuarenta cʉ̃mari ametʉenero ca cʉogʉ niiupi.
Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã cʉ̃ja ca juu buerique

Pedro, Juan jãa cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ja ca wienero jiro, ñucã cʉ̃ja mena macãrã pʉtopʉ tua waari, niipetirije paia wiorã, to biri bʉcʉrã bojocare ca jʉo niirã cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ja ca ĩirique niipetirije cʉ̃jare wedeupa.
Teere cʉ̃ja ca wedero tʉori jiro, jĩcãri mena o biro Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ĩi juu bueupa: —Niipetirije Ʉpʉ, ati ʉmʉrecore, ati yepare, dia pairi yaare, to biri teepʉre ca niirije niipetirije ca tiiricʉ,
Añuri Yeri menapʉ, mʉre pade bojari majʉ jãa ñicʉ̃ David menapʉ, o biro mʉ ĩiupa:

content.text: “¿Ñee tiirã bojoca poogaari to cõro peti cʉ̃ja wede mecʉ̃ti? ¿Ñee tiirã bojoca, watoa petira “O biro mani tiijaco,” cʉ̃ja ĩiti?
Wiorã, ati yepare ca doti niirã, jĩcãri mena Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ menare to biri mʉ ca beje amiricʉ Mesías menare, ĩa junama.”

content: To birira Herodes, Poncio Pilato, judíos, judíos ca niitirã mena, ati macãre nea pooupa, mʉ ca beje amiricʉ Jesús, ca ñañarije manigʉ, mʉre pade bojari majʉre ĩa junari,
tĩrʉmʉpʉra “To biro biirucu,” mʉ ca ĩiricarore birora, to biijato ĩirã.
Ʉpʉ, mecʉ̃ra ñañaro jãare cʉ̃ja ca tiirʉgarijere ĩaña. Mʉ paderi majare uwiricaro maniro mʉ yeere jãa ca wede yujuro jãare tiiya.
To biri mʉ ca yeri tutuarije mena ca diarique cʉtirãre catio, ñucã mʉre pade bojari majʉ ca ñañarije manigʉ Jesús wãme mena, ca ĩa ñaaña manirije jãa ca tii maji niiro tiiya —ĩi juu bueupa.

Cʉ̃ja ca juu bue yapanorora, cʉ̃ja ca niiri tabe bʉaro nanaupe. To biro ca biiro, niipetirãpʉra Añuri Yeri cʉ̃ja yeripʉre cʉ̃ ca ñaajãa nʉcã earo, uwiricaro maniro Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ wederiquere wede yujuupa.
Niipetirije cʉ̃ja ca cʉorije, niipetirã yee ca niirije

Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã niipetirã jĩcʉ̃ peere birora bii, jĩcãri cõro tʉgoeña biiupa. Jĩcʉ̃ peera cʉ̃ja ca cʉorijere, “Yʉ yee wado nii,” ĩiricaro maniro, “Mani niipetirã yee niiro bii,” ameri ĩiupa.

Jesús yee quetire wederi maja pea, Wiogʉ Jesús cʉ̃ ca cati tuarique quetire do biro tiiya maniro to birora wedecã nʉnʉa waaupa. Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pea cʉ̃ja niipetirãpʉrena bʉaro jañuro, añuro cʉ̃jare tii nemo nʉnʉa waaupi.
Cʉ̃ja watoare jĩcʉ̃ ʉnora ca boo pacagʉ maniupi. Yepari ca cʉorã, ñucã wiijeri ca cʉorã, aperãre noni wapa jeeri,
wapa tiirica tiirire Jesús buerãre tiicojori, bate dotirucuupa cʉ̃ja ca niiro cõrorena, cʉ̃ja ca cʉotirijere cʉ̃ja jeejato ĩirã.

To birora tiiupi, Leví yaa puna macʉ̃ José ca wãme cʉtigʉ, Chipre yucʉ pooga macʉ̃, Jesucristo yee quetire wederi maja, Bernabé cʉ̃ja ca wãmeo tiiricʉ cãa, (Bernabé ĩiro, “Tʉgoeña bayiricaro ca tiigʉ,” ĩirʉgaro ĩi),
cʉ̃ yaa yepare aperãre noni wapa jeeri, wapa tiirica tiirire Jesús buerãpʉre tiicojoupi.

footnotes.text: 4.13Judíos yee doti cũuriquere añuropʉ ca bue ame witiricarã.
